summary: Elong Power Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a best-efforts registered offering of 11,466,666 units, each comprising one Class A ordinary share and one warrant, at $0.12 per unit, for gross proceeds of approximately $1.38 million, closed on August 4, 2026. The warrants are exercisable immediately at $0.12 per share and expire in three years, with anti-dilution and price-adjustment provisions. This is a routine securities offering, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution from warrant exercise and future price resets.
